component.name: Quiet Paper
component.summary: Privacy-first, local-first encrypted notes and markdown journal

description.p: Quiet Paper is an elegant, distraction-free markdown note-taking app and daily journal engineered with local-first, zero-knowledge encryption.

ul.li: End-to-end local SQLite database with WAL mode and native concurrency
Per-note and vault-level zero-knowledge AES-GCM encryption
Distraction-free Markdown editor with WYSIWYG and raw preview modes
Interactive backlinks, wiki links, tags, and document attachments
Full XDG Desktop integration, responsive 3-pane layout, and keyboard shortcuts

description.p: Linux native optimization release featuring XDG Base Directory migration, WAL concurrency, single-instance GTK integration, desktop drag-and-drop, and native packages.
